destination_rect.semantics: DrawImage uses equal source/destination size; DrawScaledImage preserves independent destination size

linear.rule: four-neighbor bilinear interpolation around source pixel centers

nearest.rule: source pixel center nearest with transparent out-of-bounds samples

source_bounds.negative_source: transparent where sample is outside source image

source_rect.semantics: source x/y plus width/height are preserved from GraphicsCommand
